title: Data Cards: Purposeful and Transparent Dataset Documentation for Responsible AI
reasoning: The paper's central theme is "Responsible AI," and it proposes "Data Cards" as a framework for "purposeful and transparent dataset documentation" to support ethical considerations, fairness evaluations, and responsible deployment of models. This goes beyond a brief "Ethical Considerations" section; the entire methodology and proposed artifact are designed to operationalize ethical principles like transparency and fairness in AI development.
